$$

$F$ *is conservative if and only if $\frac{∂P}{∂y}=\frac{∂Q}{∂x}$ everywhere on $D.$*

$$

$$

- the codomain of $f$ is $Y.$

- the codomain of $f$ is $Y={12,13,14},$

- the range of $f$ is ${12,13},$ the subset of elements of $Y$ that have at least one incoming arrow.

As a result, statements II and III are false, while statement I is true.

Therefore, the correct answer "I only."

$$
T=\begin{bmatrix}-4 & 2 \\ -8 & 4\end{bmatrix}.
$$

A triangle $S$ has vertices at $(1,-1)$, $(1,0)$ and $(-2,1).$ Which of the following are coordinates of the vertices of ${S}^{′},$ the image of $S$ under the action of $T?$ 

Select all that apply.

before:
To find the image of $S$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of $S:$

$$
X=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 \\ -1 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =\begin{bmatrix}-4 & 2 \\ -8 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 \\ -1 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -4 & 10 \\ -12 & -8 & 20\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective vertices of ${S}^{′}$ are $(-6,-12)$, $(-4,-8)$ and $(10,20).$ 

So, the correct answer is "I  only."
